component.name: Sue
component.summary: Painting, comics, animation, writing and sound in one app

description.p: Sue, the Singular Unified Engine, is one creative environment. Sue Paint draws and paints with pressure-sensitive brushes, layers, vector lines, screen tones and filters, and makes comics, webtoons and frame-by-frame animation. Sue Writer writes and publishes documents and books. Every tool works on the same project, so a picture, a page and a sound are the same things wherever you use them.
It works offline, opens and saves PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, Photoshop and many other files, and has layouts for computers, tablets and phones.
